speaker: traveller
text: Nearly midnight. The forest goes quiet here.

speaker: traveller
text: A bell. There is no one out here.

speaker: traveller
text: So it is real.

speaker: traveller
text: The braziers are still burning. Someone keeps them.

speaker: traveller
text: The roof has fallen in places. Moonlight gets through.

speaker: traveller
text: A single tusk. And a warrior with an axe.

speaker: traveller
text: My lantern—

speaker: traveller
text: …and a lamp I did not light.

speaker: traveller
text: The lamps lead somewhere.

speaker: temple
text: What is remembered here is not lost. Under the moon, touch, and know.

speaker: traveller
text: The stone is warm.

speaker: temple
text: A gateway on the mountain. A warrior who will not be refused. Hold.

speaker: temple
text: Not every blow must be answered.

speaker: traveller
text: The passage. It was sealed before.

speaker: temple
text: The temple remembers what you allowed.

speaker: traveller
text: This room… I have been in this room already.

speaker: temple
text: What envies the real cannot bear the light.

speaker: traveller
text: Open to the sky. The whole chamber is waiting for the moon.

speaker: temple
text: In shadow, other doors.

speaker: traveller
text: The carving goes all the way around. It is moving.

speaker: traveller
text: It was guarding this. Not hunting me.

speaker: temple
text: Understand each line before you write it.

speaker: temple
text: Here it feeds. Here it is named: the Forgetting.

speaker: traveller
text: Untouched. All this time.

speaker: temple
text: Place each memory where it belongs.

speaker: narration
text: At sunrise, the temple was not dead. It was kept.

speaker: narration
text: Shrine lit. You can return here from the map.

speaker: temple
text: The order is written elsewhere. Look again.
